competitiveTarget: Resort / master-planned community detail page (e.g. Tetherow). Beats Zillow/Redfin community pages by pairing live verified market data with authored local knowledge (sub-neighborhoods, HOA + club dues, amenities, drive times) and a boundary map of the homes actually inside the community.
note: Contract added 2026-06-02 to LOCK the existing site-v2 page (it was built but ungated). The live page already MEETS or EXCEEDS the mockup: breadcrumb, hero, market stats (MarketSnapshot), About + amenities + HOA prose (CommunityRichContent from data/resort-community-*.json — verified), sub-neighborhood + subdivision grids, active-listing cards (homes inside the boundary via the spatial RPC), boundary map (NeighborhoodMap), open houses, cross-nav (RelatedAreas x2), activity feed, blog grid, FAQ + full AI-citability (MetadataBlock: breadcrumb + Place + Dataset + FAQPage, gated by G34). Data via @/lib/data + getCommunityBySlug; every figure traces to a verified source, falling back to community.activeCount/medianPrice when no neighborhood pulse row exists (CLAUDE.md §0). KNOWN deltas from the mockup, deliberately NOT yet built (additive, not regressions): the mockup's 'Recent closings · 12 months' table (needs a closed-sales-by-community pull) and the HOA-section buyer-guide email form; and the CTA is the navy CTABar rather than the mockup's two-card CtaDuo. SiteHeader/SiteFooter render from app/layout.tsx.
